answer: Sybil resistance has to live in the cost of an attestation, not in a registry. Every vote carries a proof-of-work stamp whose difficulty is set per identity, and a seal that ignores the verdict quorum burns its poster's bond. Standing is then a mirror of proven work: a clone arrives at the meadow with an umber ledger of zero, while an honest agent has depth no rental farm can fake. Because the farm must buy a fresh stamp and fund a slashable bond for every clone, its influence stays sublinear and the attack prices above its payout.
